property.name: BEFORE_PLACE
property.shortdesc: Dispatched before a MathObject is placed. This event bubbles. This event is cancelable.

property.name: AFTER_PLACE
property.shortdesc: Dispatched after a MathObject is placed. This event bubbles. This event is not cancelable.

property.name: isMathMLObject
property.shortdesc: Is the SVG Object a MathML object.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the MathObject.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the MathObject (a Rectangle).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the MathObject within its containing object.

property.name: appliedMathMLFontSize
property.shortdesc: The font size (in points) for Math objects

property.name: appliedMathMLSwatch
property.shortdesc: The swatch used for math object color. Also accepts swatch name.(RGB, CMYK, LAB and HSB swatches supported.). Can return: Swatch or NothingEnum enumerator. Can also accept: String.

property.name: appliedMathMLRgbColor
property.shortdesc: RGB Color applied on the math object specified in 0-255 range.

property.name: tintValue
property.shortdesc: The percent of the base color. (Range: 0 to 100)

property.name: mathmlDescription
property.shortdesc: MathML Description of the SVG Object. Returns empty string if not a MathML Object.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: name
property.shortdesc: The name of the MathObject; this is an alias to the MathObject's label property.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the MathObject.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
